messages.text: Good morning,    Just wanted to check in on this. Is this still expected to ship this month?     Have a good rest of your week,  Dalton    Sent from my iPhone

Good morning Dalton,

Yes. Your B30 on order Shop···· is in batch 1, and the date we're working to is October 15. The first units leave the manufacturer's warehouse this coming week, and batch 1 covers your order, so you're in that first wave. Dates can move a little as stock lands and gets checked in, but that is the date as it stands.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The P. Kit and the Miner Duster ship in the same box as the miner, nothing extra to pay on either. Tracking goes to this address the moment it leaves the warehouse. Our mail has been landing in junk for some folks, so it's worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts.

Have a good rest of your week.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
